Card Q&A.a: A {Security} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is face up in the security stack. It can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the face-up security cards.
They become face-up security cards that remain revealed. Other than rules that specify face-up security cards, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security cards.
Card Q&A.q: What happens to cards placed face up in the security stack by effects?

Card Q&A.a: The check is performed with the card left revealed. Other than rules for cards left revealed, the rules apply in the same manner as standard security checks.
Card Q&A.q: What happens upon a security check for a security card that is placed face-up?
Does a card's [Security] effect trigger upon a security check if that card is placed face-up?

Card Q&A.a: Any face-up cards are placed face down, then you shuffle the cards. After shuffling, all cards are left face-down.
Card Q&A.q: What happens if I shuffle a security stack that includes security cards placed face-up?

An opponent's Digimon attacks the player with an effect at the end of their turn. What happens if this card's {Security} [End of Opponent's Turn] effect then plays this card, my security stack is reduced to 0 cards, and the attack against the player is successful?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed. The conditions for this [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards.
Card Q&A.q: Can I trash just 1 specified card for the conditions of this card's [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] effect?

Effect: {Security} [End of Opponent's Turn] Play this card without paying the cost.
[When Digivolving] [End of Attack] By deleting this Digimon or trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, delete 1 of your opponent's highest DP Digimon.
[On Deletion] Your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand. Then, if their hand has 7 or fewer cards, you may place this card face up as the bottom security card.
